dialogue.content: （こんばんは、本日はよろしくお願いいたします）
dialogue.English: (Good evening, thank you for coming today.)

dialogue.content: （こんばんは。こちらこそよろしくお願い致します。）
dialogue.English: (Good evening. Thank you for having me.)

dialogue.content: こんばんは、相談員です年齢、性別、ご相談内容をお聞かせください。
dialogue.English: Good evening, I'm the counselor. Could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you'd like to talk about?

dialogue.content: 小学5年、女子クラスで急に1人になった
dialogue.English: I'm a girl in the 5th grade. I've suddenly been left all alone in my class.

dialogue.content: 話せる範囲で大丈夫です。お話できそうですか・・？
dialogue.English: It's okay to only share what you're comfortable with. Do you feel up to talking about it?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: どのようなことがありましたか？
dialogue.English: What happened?

dialogue.content: 朝学校に行ったら、口聞いてもらえなくなってた
dialogue.English: When I went to school in the morning, they just stopped talking to me.

dialogue.content: そんなことがあったのですね。それはとても辛いですよね・・。。
dialogue.English: That must have been really tough for you...

dialogue.content: 今、学年は何年生でしょうか？
dialogue.English: What grade are you in now?

dialogue.content: 5年です
dialogue.English: Fifth grade.

dialogue.content: 小学生なんですね・・急に口をきいてもらえないと悲しいし、びっくりしたよね？
dialogue.English: So you're in elementary school... It must have been sad and surprising to suddenly be ignored like that, right?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: わけわかんない
dialogue.English: I just don't understand.

dialogue.content: それはそうだよね。その時はどんな気持ちになりましたか？
dialogue.English: I can understand that. How did you feel when that happened?

dialogue.content: 急にだからわけわかんない気持ちになった
dialogue.English: Since it was so sudden, I just felt confused.

dialogue.content: そうだよね・・なんで？って思ったのかな？今は学校にはいっていますか？
dialogue.English: I understand... Did you find yourself wondering "why?"? Are you going to school now?

dialogue.content: 行ってるけど、なんか学校行くのがいやだ
dialogue.English: I'm going, but I kind of don't want to go to school.

dialogue.content: 頑張っていっているんだね。。でも、そんな風だと学校に行くのが嫌だと思うよね。
dialogue.English: You're doing your best to go. Given how things are, it's understandable that you wouldn't want to go.

dialogue.content: あなたの性別を教えてもらえますか？
dialogue.English: Could you tell me your gender?

dialogue.content: 答えたくなければ大丈夫ですよ
dialogue.English: If you'd rather not answer, that's okay.

dialogue.content: （最初に、小学5年、女子クラスで急に1人になったと送ったのですが届いてなかったでしょうか？届いていなかったらすみません(ごめんなさい)）
dialogue.English: (At the beginning, I sent a message saying I'm a 5th-grade girl who was suddenly left alone in class. Did you not receive it? I'm sorry if you didn't.)

dialogue.content: （届いてなかったです）
dialogue.English: (It didn't come through.)

dialogue.content: 急に口をきいてもらえなくなったとお話でしたが、クラス人や友達など、どんな感じですか？
dialogue.English: You mentioned that they suddenly stopped talking to you. How are things with your classmates and friends?

dialogue.content: （そうなんですね。写真送りますがバグかもですね）
dialogue.English: (I see. I'll send a screenshot; it might be a glitch.)

dialogue.content: 抜けてますね。こちらにはないですね。ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: It seems to be missing. It's not here on my end. Thank you for letting me know.

dialogue.content: いつもの友達のところへ近づくと、すーっといなくなっちゃう
dialogue.English: When I go over to my usual friends, they just slip away.

dialogue.content: （本当ですか。ありがとうございます。続けますね。）
dialogue.English: (Really? Thank you. I'll continue.)

dialogue.content: そうなんですね・・それは寂しいし、嫌だよね。そんなとき、あなたはどうしてるのかな？
dialogue.English: I see... That must feel lonely and awful. What do you do at times like that?

dialogue.content: 休憩時間は一人で席に座ってる
dialogue.English: During break time, I just sit at my desk by myself.

dialogue.content: 寂しいっていうか、わけわかんない
dialogue.English: It's not just lonely—it's more like I just don't get it.

dialogue.content: そうなんだね。いつ頃からそんな感じなのかな？
dialogue.English: I see. About how long has it been like this?

dialogue.content: 1週間くらい前
dialogue.English: About a week ago.

dialogue.content: そうなんだね・・何かきっかけや思いあたるようなことはあるのかな？
dialogue.English: I see... Is there anything you can think of that might have triggered this?

dialogue.content: わからないなんで？って思う
dialogue.English: I don't know. I just keep thinking, "Why?"

dialogue.content: わたしが、なんかしたのかなあ
dialogue.English: I wonder if I did something wrong.

dialogue.content: そう思うんだね・・
dialogue.English: That's what you're thinking...

dialogue.content: 今までそんなに仲良しじゃなかった子が急に私は味方だよって言ってきた
dialogue.English: A girl I wasn't that close to before suddenly came up to me and said, "I'm on your side."

dialogue.content: わけわかんない
dialogue.English: It's so confusing.

dialogue.content: そうなの？口をきいてくれない友達じゃなくて、、
dialogue.English: Really? Not the friends who aren't talking to you, but...

dialogue.content: 別の子が急に私は味方だよって言ってきたのかな？？
dialogue.English: A different girl suddenly came and said she's on your side?

dialogue.content: はい。あといつも一緒に帰る子は一緒に歩いてるけど、何も言わない。なんか困った顔してた
dialogue.English: Yes. Also, the friend I always walk home with still walks with me, but she doesn't say anything. She looked kind of troubled.

dialogue.content: そうなんだね。一緒に帰っている子はなんで困った顔をしているのかな・・？
dialogue.English: I see. I wonder why the friend you walk home with looks troubled...?

dialogue.content: わかんない
dialogue.English: I don't know.

dialogue.content: そうなんだね・・。こうなる前は学校は楽しかったのかな？
dialogue.English: I understand. Before this happened, was school fun?

dialogue.content: ふつうに楽しかったと思う
dialogue.English: I think it was just normally fun.

dialogue.content: うんうん。急に口を聞いてくれない理由が分からなくて学校に行くのが嫌なんだね？
dialogue.English: Mmm-hmm. So you don't want to go to school because you don't know why they've suddenly stopped talking to you?

dialogue.content: 行っても一人だし
dialogue.English: Even if I go, I'm all alone.

dialogue.content: 急に味方だよって言われたのも謎で
dialogue.English: And it's a mystery why that other girl suddenly said she's on my side.

dialogue.content: 口聞いてもらえないのもそうだけど
dialogue.English: It's not just about them not talking to me...

dialogue.content: なんかおこってるのかなあ
dialogue.English: I wonder if they're mad at me about something.

dialogue.content: そう思うんだね。。何か怒らせるようなこと？あったかな？
dialogue.English: That's what you think... Can you think of anything you might have done to make them angry?

dialogue.content: わからないでも一緒の帰り道の子がとても困ってるみたいだった。
dialogue.English: I don't know. But the friend I walk home with looked really troubled.

dialogue.content: 誰かに命令されてるのかなぁ
dialogue.English: I wonder if someone is telling them what to do.

dialogue.content: そうおもうんだね。
dialogue.English: That's what you're thinking.

dialogue.content: 口をきいてくれない友達にちょくせつ聞いてみることはできるのかな？
dialogue.English: Do you think you could ask the friends who aren't talking to you directly?

dialogue.content: それか、一緒に帰っている友達に相談してみるのはどうかな？
dialogue.English: Or how about talking to the friend you walk home with about it?

dialogue.content: ちょくせつきくなんてむり
dialogue.English: There's no way I can ask them directly.

dialogue.content: 帰ってる子にも何を聞くの？誰かに命令されてるの？なんて聞けないよ
dialogue.English: And what would I even ask the kid I walk home with? “Is someone telling you to do this?” I couldn't ask that.

dialogue.content: 例えばだけど、急に口をきいてくれないんだけど、どうしたらいいかな？とか・・何かしたのかな？とか・・
dialogue.English: For example, you could say something like, "They suddenly stopped talking to me, what should I do?" or... "Did I do something wrong?"

dialogue.content: きかなきゃだめなのかな？
dialogue.English: Do I have to ask?

dialogue.content: 聞きたくなければ聞かなくてもいいと思う。理由が知りたいのかなって思ったので、、
dialogue.English: If you don't want to ask, you don't have to. I just thought you might want to know the reason...

dialogue.content: あなたはどうしたいとかあるかな？
dialogue.English: What would you like to happen?

dialogue.content: 普通に話せるようにしたい。黙った帰るのは嫌だ。ひとりぼっちはいやだ
dialogue.English: I want to be able to talk with them normally again. I hate walking home in silence. I don't want to be all alone.

dialogue.content: そう思っているんだね・・。あなたがここに相談に来てくれたので、どうしたら普通に話せるのかを考えたくて、、
dialogue.English: I see that's how you feel... Since you came here to talk, I'd like to help you think about how you can start talking normally again...

dialogue.content: どうしたらいいの？
dialogue.English: What should I do?

dialogue.content: 休み時間など一人は嫌なんだよね。けんかしているわけじゃないけど、ちょくせつは聞けないし・・
dialogue.English: You don't want to be alone during break time, right? It's not like you're fighting, but you can't ask them directly...

dialogue.content: 誰かに聞くのは聞けないんだよね？
dialogue.English: And you feel you can't ask anyone, right?

dialogue.content: 誰かって先生とかってこと？
dialogue.English: "Anyone," do you mean like a teacher?

dialogue.content: 先生に相談とか・・クラスの他の子と話したりとかできるのかな・・？
dialogue.English: Like talking to a teacher... or could you maybe talk to other kids in your class...?

dialogue.content: 急に口聞いてくれなくなりましたっていうの？
dialogue.English: Am I supposed to say, “They suddenly stopped talking to me”?

dialogue.content: なんかやだ
dialogue.English: That feels weird.

dialogue.content: 話したら相手にもいうでしよ？なんかやだ
dialogue.English: If I tell them, they'll tell the others, won't they? I don't like that.

dialogue.content: つげぐちみたい
dialogue.English: It feels like tattling.

dialogue.content: そっかそっか・。できるならちょくせつ聞いて仲直りした方がいいのかな・・
dialogue.English: I see, I see... If possible, it might be best to ask them directly and make up...

dialogue.content: 勇気がいるかもしれないけど・・
dialogue.English: It might take some courage, though...

dialogue.content: それができてたらやってると思う
dialogue.English: If I could do that, I would have done it already.

dialogue.content: うんうん・・。ここに勇気を出して相談に来てくれたので、あなたならできるかな？って・・
dialogue.English: Mmm-hmm... You showed courage by coming here to talk, so I thought maybe you could do it...?

dialogue.content: たくさんお話をしてくれてありがとうございます。どうしたら普通にはなせるようにできるかを次回一緒に考えたいです・・
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing so much with me. Next time, I'd like for us to think together about how you can start talking normally again...

dialogue.content: あなたがお話したいことを聞いてあげられてなかったかもしれません・・。
dialogue.English: I may not have been able to listen to what you truly wanted to talk about...

dialogue.content: わかりました
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 結局わけわかんないけど
dialogue.English: In the end, I still don't get it, but...

dialogue.content: 時間あったらまたきます
dialogue.English: I'll come back when I have time.

dialogue.content: そうですよね・・次にお話をする時に、一緒に考えていきたいです。今日はここで終了になりますが、今日はきてくれてありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: I understand... I'd like for us to think about it together when we talk next time. We'll end here for today, but thank you so much for coming.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: （今日はありがとうございました。またよろしくお願いいたします。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for today. I look forward to speaking with you again.)
